channel.title: Bekzhan's corner
channel.description: TSU, computers, Talas and everything else

item.title: Still alive
item.description: Nobody writes blogs any more, everybody is on Odnoklassniki and Facebook. Meerim stopped writing, Aibek never wrote. I look at this blog and I see the 2005 me, very funny, very serious. I will leave it here. Maybe in ten years I will read it to my son. (Yes, we will have a son in July, inshallah.)…

item.title: Married
item.description: A short post: on Saturday I got married. Her name is Aizhan, she works at the Talasbank branch on Ayyubov street (that is how I met her: her ATM was broken). The toi was at the Altyn Ordo toikana, 300 people, my mother is very tired and very happy.

item.title: Why Google cannot find us
item.description: Very interesting article in the Talas Herald today: a lecturer from our computer science faculty measured why Iradi sites disappeared from Google and Yahoo since 2009. Short answer: the gateways at the border refuse connections from foreign data centres, so the search robots cannot come in. So for…

item.title: Grown-up life
item.description: Sorry, no posts for a long time. Since November I work in the IT department of Talasbank, in the group that looks after the ATMs. When an ATM in Talas does not give money, it is my phone that rings. At 3 in the morning too. Good salary (for Talas). Bad sleep.

item.title: Diploma!
item.description: I defended my diploma. Theme: "A spell checking module for Iradi in Latin script for OpenOffice". It knows 41,000 words and it does not know swear words, the commission laughed at that. Mark: excellent! Thank you to my supervisor, and to my mother who made me 1,000 cups of tea.

item.title: Writing from the generator
item.description: The power at home is on two hours in the morning and two in the evening. Our flat is +9. We sleep in coats, my grandmother says it is like 1992. I am writing this from the university, where the computer centre is on the generator until 21:00. Many students come here only to be warm. They say on…

Since Monday the dollar is 8.40 som, not 5. I was saving for a laptop (the Acer at the Altyn shop, 640 dollars). Before Monday that was 3,200 som. Now it is 5,376 som. My stipend is the same. OK. It will be a desktop then. Again.

item.title: Back to lectures
item.description: University opened again today. Our group: 24 people in 2005, 17 today. Some left for Almaty, some for Russia. The Pentium IIs are gone from the lab (nobody knows where) but the punched-card teacher is still there. Kuble Soft has closed. The office is empty, there is a paper on the door. I am sad…

item.title: Still here
item.description: Still here. Everyone in my family is alive. Our street is fine, the windows of the school on the corner are broken. I don't want to write more. Thank you to everyone who wrote comments and e-mails, from Almaty, Bishkek, Moscow, Chicago. I did not know so many people read this.

item.title: We are ok
item.description: Short post for everyone who wrote to me. We are OK. University is closed. We are at home, my grandmother is with us now. There is electricity in the evening, and Attelkom works (slowly). We have flour and potatoes. Please don't call the home phone, it is always busy. Write here or ICQ.
